A '''colony world''' of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was ruled by a grand chieftain during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and the chieftain allowed his people to freely prey on passing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] until intimidated by offworlders.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Show of Strength}}</ref>
